Action: US President Donald Trump says he will charge vessels a 20% tax to cross the Strait of Hormuz under the watch of US forces. The claim has been met with bafflement in the shipping industry - not least because it’s far more than Iran planned to charge ships before the ceasefire. Iran would have charged the operator of a very large crude carrier (VLCC) the equivalent of $2 per barrel. A VLCC carries about two million barrels, so that could be $4 million per vessel - but few firms are thought to have paid the so-called ‘Tehran tollbooth’. Trump’s plan would far exceed that, costing tens of millions of dollars. 'With current Brent price ($76), that’s $16 a barrel will go to Trump', said Amena Bak
